Maya (People Ops): FYI — building maintenance found an old transformer fault. SF hub will be on partial power this Thursday (one day). Please read carefully; some services will be affected. :warning:

Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: Hub open but limited capacity; no hot-desk access on the 6th floor; conference rooms on the 3rd floor remain available. If you planned an onsite client demo, consider moving to another day or request an exception. Guest prereg still required.

Ivy (Facilities): What9s impacted: 6th floor lighting and some outlets will be offline, kitchen hot water intermittent, and the wall chargers in the bike room will be down. Building HVAC unaffected. Security desk will stay open 8:30-17:30.

Omar (Eng): Can we still run hardware tests in the lab?

IT Support: Short answer: not if you need powered racks. The test bench on 2nd floor (battery-backed) is available but space is limited. Open a ticket with subject `power-pilot` + dates to request slot.

Lina (Sales): Customer demo tomorrow — can we get a room with A/V?

Maya (People Ops): We9ve reserved two A/V-ready rooms on 3rd floor for approved customer demos. Submit demo requests using `room booking` and include "demo: power-day" in notes. We9ll prioritize external-facing demos.

Security Bot: External visitors: badge pickup still at lobby. All guests must complete the short safety briefing link in the prereg confirmation. No unescorted after-hours access.

Ivy (Facilities): Parking: only 6 visitor spots available. If you need parking for a customer, include license plate and arrival window in the booking form.

Omar (Eng): Any change to shuttle? I usually take the 7:40 inbound run.

Maya (People Ops): Shuttle schedule unchanged but capacity may be limited; please sign up as usual. If the shuttle fills we9ll add a second van for the morning.

IT Support: Note on VPN credentials for contractors: temporary creds will be issued only if contractor is preregistered and has a signed NDA on file. Submit requests 48h in advance.

Lina (Sales): Will there be any food options? We were planning client lunch onsite.

Maya (People Ops): Catering allowed but must be building-approved vendors and delivered sealed to the lobby. Submit catering requests 72h prior and mark "power-day" in notes so Facilities can route.

Omar (Eng): If my team needs to work remotely that day, is there an offsite stipend?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — people asked to work fully remote for power reasons can claim a $20 remote-work stipend for that day. Submit expenses with tag `SF-power-06` in Concur.

Maya (People Ops): Pilot timeline: Thu 6th 08:00-18:00. We expect normal ops to resume Friday. If anything changes we9ll post updates here and ping #general. Questions or urgent exception requests -> DM me or @Ivy. :white_check_mark:
